narrative.overview: RXperiences is a personal pharmacy publication from Kuwait: first-hand study and career stories, a policy directory and a research shelf, told in a warm Kuwaiti voice. The system frames those stories like a magazine and lets the brand's hand-made sticker world live in the frame, never in the reading column. The page is light and calm by default; colour commits at section scale; stories speak in Naskh, the brand and interface in Rubik.
keyCharacteristics: Two voices: Amiri / Noto Naskh for stories, Rubik for brand and interface.
Lists and rails separated by hairlines, not bordered cards.
Category colour coding like medicine-box bands.
The navy outline + offset sticker belongs only to mascots and primary buttons.
Right-to-left first; English inside Arabic is handled, not ignored.

rules.name: The Medicine-Box Rule
rules.body: Each category owns one colour: UK & Ireland lilac, USA & Canada candy, Arab countries sunny, pharmacy articles navy. It appears as a short band before the category name, as the mat behind a post with no image, and as a full frame around region photos — never as a one-sided stripe.

rules.name: The Section-Scale Rule
rules.body: Colour fills whole sections (masthead, policies band, author band), not individual components.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: If it is a story (its title or its text), it is set in Naskh. Everything else is Rubik.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Category labels sit in the meta line under a title, never above it.

rules.name: The Sticker Rule
rules.body: The ink outline + hard offset belongs to the mascot world: primary buttons, speech bubbles, the mascot dock. Never on cards, images, list rows or panels.

dos: Do set every story title in Amiri 700 and article text in Noto Naskh, with English falling back to Rubik.
Do use the category colour from the Medicine-Box Rule wherever a category is named.
Do separate list items with 1px hairlines and space, not boxes.
Do keep the reading column at 35em or less and line-height 1.95.
Do give motion one orchestrated moment (the home masthead) and respect reduced motion.
Do mark English-only blocks inside articles as left-to-right.
donts: Don't put the navy outline + offset shadow on cards, images or panels.
Don't put labels or eyebrows above headings.
Don't use grey text on coloured bands; tint from the band or use navy.
Don't add colour stripes along one side of an element.
Don't load fonts from Google Fonts; they are self-hosted in /public/fonts.
